{{Quote|Immediately following this session, we shall submit a list of our fallen Imperial patriots, martyrs who gave everything on the brutal streets of Ghorman. A list, that even now, grows longer as the full measure of the Ghorman perfidy comes into focus.|Nico, in a session of the senate regarding the Ghorman Massacre|audio=Nico-WelcomeToTheRebellion.flac|<ref name="Welcome" />}}
'''Nico''' was a [[Color|white]]-[[Hair|furred]] [[Unidentified two-pronged-ears species|alien]] who served as a [[senator]] in the [[Imperial Senate]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. The [[Local day|day]] after the [[Ghorman Massacre]] in [[2 BBY]], they spoke at a senate session in the [[Imperial Senate Building]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] and revealed that they would be submitting a list of the [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] that had [[Death|died]] on Ghorman after the session. Nico called the Imperials martyrs, and spoke against the [[Ghorman (people)|Ghorman]] people who had been massacred, following [[Anti-Ghorman whispering campaign|anti-Ghorman]] talking points the Empire had long been pushing.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Of all the things at risk, the loss of an objective reality is perhaps the most dangerous. The death of truth is the ultimate victory of evil. When truth leaves us, when we let it slip away, when it is ripped from our hands, we become vulnerable to the appetite of whatever monster screams the loudest.|Mon Mothma|audio=Mothma-LossOfTruth-WelcomeToTheRebellion.flac|<ref name="Welcome" />}}
[[File:NicoSenateChamber-WelcomeToTheRebellion.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Senator Nico stands alone in a repulsorpod floating toward the middle of the Senate Chamber with dozens of other pods lining the walls. The Oathkeeper watches from the Chancellor's Podium at the center of the chamber.|Nico spoke before the Senate the day after the Ghorman Massacre.]]
Nico was an [[Unidentified two-pronged-ears species|alien]] [[senator]] in the [[Imperial Senate]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Welcome" /> In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|209}}</ref> after a prolonged Imperial [[Anti-Ghorman whispering campaign|whispering campaign]] to turn [[the galaxy]] against the [[Ghorman (people)|Ghorman]] people of the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]],<ref name="OYL">{{Andor|One Year Later}}</ref> the Empire orchestrated a [[Ghorman Massacre|massacre]] there<ref name="WAY">{{Andor|Who Are You?}}</ref> that [[Death|killed]] hundreds or thousands of the [[Homeworld|natives]],<ref name="Rise">''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''</ref> as well as some [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]]. While some [[Ghorman Front|resistance members]] fought back during the Imperial attack, news coverage of the event spun it as a full insurrection by the Ghorman with help from outside agitators.<ref name="WAY" />

The following [[Local day|day]], an early session of the senate with a set agenda was called in the [[Imperial Senate Building]] on<ref name="Welcome" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Rise" /> [[Coruscant]]. After the Senate's [[Unidentified Oathkeeper|Oathkeeper]] declared a quorum and called the session to order, Nico stood alone in a [[repulsorpod]] hovering in the [[Galactic Senate Chamber]] and spoke before those gathered. The [[alien]] declared that, immediately following the session, they would submit a list of Imperial "patriots" who had died on Ghorman, calling them martyrs as their list grew "longer" even as they spoke; the senator characterized the world as brutal and its residents deceitful and untrustworthy.<ref name="Welcome" />

[[File:NicoPod-WelcomeToTheRebellion.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Senator Nico, in black and orange robes, stands in a repulsorpod speaking before the Imperial Senate.|Nico spoke against the Ghorman people and called the Imperials who had died during the massacre martyrs.]]
Senators [[Den Gane]] and [[Karloo]] spoke after Nico and shared similar sentiments, but when [[Senior Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] took the floor, she decried the senate as having lost sight of the truth about what had happened on Ghorman. She called it a genocide and declared [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] a monster, after which the live feed of the session was cut. As many senators yelled accusations of treachery at her, Mothma exited the chamber and [[Escape from the Senate|fled]] from Coruscant.<ref name="Welcome" />

==Personality and traits==
Nico used anti-Ghorman talking points pushed by the Empire while speaking in senate, aligning themself with the [[soldier]]s who had died in the massacre and against the many civilians. The alien had [[Color|white]] [[Hair|fur]] and tan skin.<ref name="Welcome" />

==Equipment==
During the senate session the [[Standard day|day]] after the Ghorman Massacre, Nico wore black and orange [[Clothing|robes]] and a golden necklace.<ref name="Welcome" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:NicoConcept-IvanManzella.jpg|thumb|right|350px|alt=Concept art of Nico shows the character with more webbed, horn-like protrusions on top of their head and wearing black robes.|Ivan Manzella created concept art of Nico.]]
Nico appeared in "[[Welcome to the Rebellion]]," the ninth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']],<ref name="Welcome" /> which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> Concept art for the character was created by [[Ivan Manzella]],<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creature & Character Designs|author=[[Ivan Manzella|Manzella, Ivan]]|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20250715083228}}</ref> with its 3D printed mold designed by [[Brian Best]], reinforced with fiberglass for running in foam latex by [[Robert Skene]] as part of work done for [[Neal Scanlan]]'s creature shop, with [[Kenny Wilson]] serving as Moldshop HOD.<ref name="SkeneInstagram">{{Instagram|username=robskenefx|url=/p/DOG06p5jXin|name=[[Robert Skene]]|date=2025-09-03|quote=This character, was another 3d printed mold designed by @brianbestfx, that I reinforced with fiberglass for running in foam latex. All work done for Neal Scanlan's creature shop, with Kenny Wilson as Moldshop HOD.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/h7bt3}}</ref>

The episode's subtitles identify both Nico and Gane as "Senator Nico" when they speak, although an [[Aurebesh]] caption on a monitor correctly identifies Gane during the other senator's dialogue.<ref name="Welcome" /> The episode's credits, which lists the characters in order of appearance, also list Senator Gane prior to Senator Nico despite Nico appearing before Gane in the episode itself. Both characters were performed by [[Caitlin Nicholas]] and voiced by [[Colin Purves]].<ref name="Welcome" /> [[Ivan Manzella]] created concept art of Nico.<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creature & Character Designs|author=[[Ivan Manzella|Manzella, Ivan]]|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20250715083228}}</ref> The senators' names are also swapped in the episode's script, which was released on [[Disney Debut]].<ref name="Script">{{Disney|subdomain=assets.debut|url=documents/Andor%20209%20--%20POST%20FINAL%20--%203.3.24%5B1%5D.pdf|text=Episode #209 "Welcome To The Rebellion" Script|format=PDF}}</ref>
